column1: An airborne reintroduction programme has helped conservationists take significant steps to protect the endangered Galapagos tortoise.
column2: 一项通过空运将象龟重新引入野外的计划，帮助自然保护工作者在保护濒危的加拉帕戈斯象龟方面迈出了重要一步。

column1: Forests of spiny cacti cover much of the uneven lava plains that separate the interior of the Galapagos island of Isabela from the Pacific Ocean.
column2: 在加拉帕戈斯群岛的伊莎贝拉岛上，高低不平的熔岩平原将岛屿内陆与太平洋隔开，平原大部分地方都长着成林的带刺仙人掌。

column1: With its five distinct volcanoes, the island resembles a lunar landscape.
column2: 岛上有五座轮廓分明的火山，整座岛看起来像月球表面。

column1: Only the thick vegetation at the skirt of the often cloud-covered peak of Sierra Negra offers respite from the barren terrain below.
column2: 内格拉火山的峰顶常常笼罩在云中。唯有山脚的茂密植被，才让人能暂时摆脱低处那片荒芜的地貌。
column6: offers respite|让人得以暂时摆脱

column1: This inhospitable environment is home to the giant Galapagos tortoise.
column2: 这片环境恶劣的土地，却是巨大的加拉帕戈斯象龟的家园。

column1: Some time after the Galapagos’s birth, around five million years ago, the islands were colonised by one or more tortoises from mainland South America.
column2: 加拉帕戈斯群岛约于500万年前形成。此后某个时候，一只或多只来自南美大陆的陆龟来到岛上定居。
column3: Some time after|在……后的某个时候
column4: around five million years ago|约五百万年前

column1: As these ancestral tortoises settled on the individual islands, the different populations adapted to their unique environments, giving rise to at least 14 different subspecies.
column2: 当这些祖先陆龟分别在各岛定居时，各个种群适应了自己独特的环境，进而形成了至少14个不同的亚种。

column1: Island life agreed with them.
column2: 岛上的生活很适合它们。

column1: In the absence of significant predators, they grew to become the largest and longest-living tortoises on the planet, weighing more than 400 kilograms, occasionally exceeding 1.8 metres in length and living for more than a century.
column2: 由于没有强大的天敌，它们长成了地球上体型最大、寿命最长的陆龟：体重可超过400公斤，体长偶尔超过1.8米，寿命超过一个世纪。
column3: In the absence of|在缺少……的情况下

column1: Before human arrival, the archipelago’s tortoises numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
column2: 在人类到来之前，群岛上的陆龟数以十万计。
column5: numbered in the hundreds of thousands|数量达数十万

column1: From the 17th century onwards, pirates took a few on board for food, but the arrival of whaling ships in the 1790s saw this exploitation grow exponentially.
column2: 从17世纪起，海盗就会带少量陆龟上船充作食物；到了18世纪90年代，捕鲸船的到来让这种捕捉的规模呈指数级增长。
column7: exploitation|n. 对陆龟的捕取利用

column1: Relatively immobile and capable of surviving for months without food or water, the tortoises were taken on board these ships to act as food supplies during long ocean passages.
column2: 陆龟相对不爱动，并能在不吃不喝的情况下活上数月，因此被带上这些船，充当漫长远洋航程中的食物储备。
column7: long ocean passages|漫长的远洋航程

column1: Sometimes, their bodies were processed into high-grade oil.
column2: 有时，人们还把龟体加工成优质油。

column1: In total, an estimated 200,000 animals were taken from the archipelago before the 20th century.
column2: 估计到20世纪之前，共有20万只陆龟被从群岛带走。

column1: This historical exploitation was then exacerbated when settlers came to the islands.
column2: 后来，随着移民来到群岛，这种由来已久的掠取进一步加剧了。

column1: They hunted the tortoises and destroyed their habitat to clear land for agriculture.
column2: 他们捕猎陆龟，还为了开垦农地而毁坏陆龟的栖息地。

column1: They also introduced alien species — ranging from cattle, pigs, goats, rats and dogs to plants and ants — that either prey on the eggs and young tortoises or damage or destroy their habitat.
column2: 他们还引入了外来物种，从牛、猪、山羊、老鼠和狗，到植物和蚂蚁都有。这些物种有的捕食龟卵和幼龟，有的损害甚至摧毁龟的栖息地。

column1: Today, only 11 of the original subspecies survive and of these, several are highly endangered.
column2: 如今，原来的亚种中只有11个存续至今，其中还有几个处于高度濒危状态。

column1: In 1989, work began on a tortoise-breeding centre just outside the town of Puerto Villamil on Isabela, dedicated to protecting the island’s tortoise populations.
column2: 1989年，伊莎贝拉岛上维利亚米尔港镇外开始建设一座陆龟繁育中心，专门保护岛上的陆龟种群。

column1: The centre’s captive-breeding programme proved to be extremely successful, and it eventually had to deal with an overpopulation problem.
column2: 中心的圈养繁育计划极为成功，以至于最终不得不面对陆龟数量过多的问题。

column1: The problem was also a pressing one.
column2: 这个问题还很紧迫。

column1: Captive-bred tortoises can’t be reintroduced into the wild until they’re at least five years old and weigh at least 4.5 kilograms, at which point their size and weight — and their hardened shells — are sufficient to protect them from predators.
column2: 圈养繁殖的陆龟至少要满五岁、体重达到4.5公斤，才能被重新放归野外。到了这个阶段，它们的体型、体重，以及已经变硬的龟甲，才足以保护它们免受天敌侵害。
column4: reintroduced into the wild|重新放归野外

column1: But if people wait too long after that point, the tortoises eventually become too large to transport.
column2: 但如果过了这个阶段又等得太久，陆龟最终会长得太大，无法运送。
column4: after that point|过了那个阶段
column6: too large to transport|大到无法运送

column1: For years, repatriation efforts were carried out in small numbers, with the tortoises carried on the backs of men over weeks of long, treacherous hikes along narrow trails.
column2: 多年以来，每次只能送少量陆龟回归原栖息地。人们得把龟背在背上，沿狭窄的小径艰难地跋涉数周，路途漫长而危险。
column3: repatriation efforts|送回原栖息地的行动
column5: on the backs of men|由人背负

column1: But in November 2010, the environmentalist and Galapagos National Park liaison officer Godfrey Merlin, a visiting private motor yacht captain and a helicopter pilot gathered around a table in a small café in Puerto Ayora on the island of Santa Cruz to work out more ambitious reintroduction.
column2: 但2010年11月，环保人士兼加拉帕戈斯国家公园联络官戈弗雷·默林、一位到访的私人机动游艇船长和一名直升机飞行员，在圣克鲁斯岛阿约拉港的一家小咖啡馆里围桌而坐，商讨规模更大的放归行动。
column9: ambitious reintroduction|规模更大的重引入行动

column1: The aim was to use a helicopter to move 300 of the breeding centre’s tortoises to various locations close to Sierra Negra.
column2: 他们的目标是用直升机把繁育中心的300只陆龟运到内格拉火山附近的多个地点。

column1: This unprecedented effort was made possible by the owners of the 67-metre yacht White Cloud, who provided the Galapagos National Park with free use of their helicopter and its experienced pilot, as well as the logistical support of the yacht, its captain and crew.
column2: 这项史无前例的行动得以实现，要归功于长67米的游艇“白云号”的船主。他们让国家公园免费使用船上的直升机，并由经验丰富的飞行员执飞，还派出游艇、船长及船员提供后勤支援。
column4: made possible by|因……才得以实现
column7: experienced pilot|经验丰富的飞行员

column1: Originally an air ambulance, the yacht’s helicopter has a rear double door and a large internal space that’s well suited for cargo, so a custom crate was designed to hold up to 33 tortoises with a total weight of about 150 kilograms.
column2: 游艇的直升机原是一架空中救护机，后部有双扇舱门，内部宽敞，很适合载货。因此人们专门设计了一个运输箱，最多可装33只陆龟，总重约150公斤。
column4: rear double door|后部双扇舱门

column1: This weight, together with that of the fuel, pilot and four crew, approached the helicopter’s maximum payload, and there were times when it was clearly right on the edge of the helicopter’s capabilities.
column2: 加上燃油、飞行员和四名工作人员的重量，这一载荷已接近直升机的最大有效载荷；有好几次，显然已经到了飞机承载能力的极限。
column7: right on the edge of|正好处在……的极限

column1: During a period of three days, a group of volunteers from the breeding centre worked around the clock to prepare the young tortoises for transport.
column2: 在三天时间里，繁育中心的一组志愿者昼夜不停地工作，为运送幼龟做好准备。
column3: a period of three days|三天时间

column1: Meanwhile, park wardens, dropped off ahead of time in remote locations, cleared landing sites within the thick brush, cacti and lava rocks.
column2: 与此同时，公园巡护员提前被送到偏远地点，在茂密的灌木、仙人掌和熔岩石之间清理出着陆场。

column1: Upon their release, the juvenile tortoises quickly spread out over their ancestral territory, investigating their new surroundings and feeding on the vegetation.
column2: 一经放归，这些幼龟很快便散布到祖先的栖息地，探索新的环境，取食当地植被。

column1: Eventually, one tiny tortoise came across a fully grown giant who had been lumbering around the island for around a hundred years.
column2: 后来，一只小小的陆龟遇到了一只成年的庞然大物。那只大龟已在岛上慢悠悠地走了约一百年。
column7: around a hundred years|大约一百年

column1: The two stood side by side, a powerful symbol of the regeneration of an ancient species.
column2: 两只龟并肩而立，成为这个古老物种恢复生机的有力象征。
